text:
jamie: Quick postmortem follow-up thread for the canary incident yesterday. Need an action tracker with owners + dates so we can close the loop. Primary themes: stronger flag blast-radius defaults, runtime auto-rollback hooks, and a recurrence detector for repeated patterns.

maria: thanks. please spell out owners + firm due dates. short bullets preferred.

jamie: suggested assignments (open to edits):
- @maria -> rollout policy & validation tests (unit + e2e smoke) — due 2026-04-09
- @lex -> runtime rollback API + control-plane handshake (returns rollback_key) — due 2026-04-16
- @elaine -> telemetry pipeline + recurrence detector prototype — due 2026-04-20
- @kevin -> CI gating + canary-sim job in pipelines — due 2026-04-08
- @olivia -> runbook updates + quarterly drill scheduling — due 2026-04-05
I'll create the GH tracker and link PRs. :white_check_mark:

lex: ack. question on signals: do we want multi-signal predicates (e.g., error rate AND latency) or OR logic? runtime needs clear semantics.

elaine: propose this to start: sustained 4m error_rate >= 2.5% OR p95 latency > 3x baseline for 2 consecutive 1m windows OR failure_ratio spike (current/median) >= 3 within 3m. Also detect extremely fast traffic shifts to the new variant (>50% in 2m). We can iterate thresholds after a few drills.

kevin: for CI gating I'm adding a canary-sim job that replays sampled production traffic against the canary variant in a sandbox. Example job snippet:```bash
jobs:
  canary-sim:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - run: ./tools/replay_traffic --from ts-2026-03-01 --variant canary --check-metrics
```
This will fail the rollout if smoke assertions fail.

maria: flag defaults: max_blast_radius = 8% for service-level flags, per-route override requires explicit approver list and a safety justification. Also require a safety_profile field on every rollout config.

jamie: rough policy DSL sample (for the policy doc):
```yaml
policy_name: small-batch-safety
triggers:
  - id: immediate_failure
    when: error_rate >= 0.025 for 4m
    action: rollback_immediate
  - id: latency_degradation
    when: p95 > 3 * baseline for 2 windows
    action: reduce_traffic_percent: 60
  - id: traffic_surge
    when: new_variant_share >= 0.5 within 2m
    action: route_to_stable
```
feel free to propose naming/threshold tweaks.

lex: runtime API note: rollout POST should accept safety_profile_id and return { rollout_id, rollback_key } on success. The runtime will store rollback_key scoped to rollout_id for 48h. Will draft API spec and link.

elaine: recurrence detector plan: cluster canary incidents by fingerprint (service, endpoint, model_version, deploy_time_bucket). Alert if a fingerprint occurs 2x within 14 days and include contextual diffs (traffic mix, config changes). Emit a weekly short digest + urgent alerts if a match reaches the 2x threshold. Need access to historical canary metrics and deploy metadata (cc @infra).

kevin: CI infra note: canary-sim relies on a stable replay bucket. I pushed a small harness to the tracker. Running at low cadence until infra approves storage lifecycle. :wrench:

olivia: I can take the runbook + drill cadence. Plan: tabletop drill within 2 weeks, full drill in 6 weeks. I'll add runbook steps for using rollback_key and include sample commands.

jamie: runbook snippet for ops pages (draft):
```yaml
on_alert:
  - notify: #oncall
  - dashboard: canary-overview
  - check: canary-replay-success
  - if: immediate_failure -> run: /scripts/execute_rollback --key ${rollback_key}
  - create: postmortem-draft --template canary
```

ops-bot: Reminder created: tabletop drill on 2026-04-07 09:30 UTC assigned to olivia.

maria: small ask: add unit tests for the policy DSL parser and wire a CI check to prevent invalid policy uploads. I'll own the tests but need a schema + examples.

jamie: noted. I'll open the tracker issue now and attach this thread. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/420 (tracker + checklist). Please add PR links there as you create them.

elaine: pinging infra for metrics access (cc @infra).

lex: filing API spec PR now, will link in issue.

kevin: CI canary-sim PR is up, link in tracker. still flaky on storage perms but progressing.

jamie: thanks all. let's use the tracker to mark items done. weekly sync until everything's closed. if anyone gets blocked, post here and I'll escalate. :eyes:
